title: Dinner with Dev
summary: Jordan had a second dinner with Dev at a Thai restaurant, nearly bailing beforehand from anxiety but quickly relaxing once Dev arrived, and the two ended up talking for hours, sharing music, and sketching a "free play" feature idea for Jordan's Coda app on a napkin after Dev pointed out a gap in the wireframes. Jordan felt genuinely happy and connected, especially after Dev sent an unprompted bass cover text later that night, and is consciously trying not to overanalyze the growing feelings. No major decisions were made beyond resolving to build the free-play feature and to keep seeing Dev without overthinking it.
